## Description / Açıklama
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.
Değişikliklerin özetini ve ilgili sorunu belirtiniz.

## Type of Change / Değişiklik Türü
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) / Hata düzeltmesi
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) / Yeni özellik
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Dokümantasyon güncellemesi

## How Has This Been Tested? / Nasıl Test Edildi?
- [ ] Tested on 2K (2560x1440) resolution
- [ ] Tested on 1080p resolution
- [ ] Tested Emergency Stop (ESC / F10)
- [ ] Tested 18-color palette switching

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows PEP 8 style guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or crashes.
